land:
{directive}You lead {agent}. {balance}

{doctrine}Decision point {point}, {title}. {situation} {question} {others}The crew has already done its drill (cover, and return fire if it can see the shooter). Compare reach both ways and numbers before choosing.
balance: The intent comes first; keep the unit alive and able to carry it out; take a local opportunity only when it doesn't cost the intent. A unit that keeps its strength can still take the objective; one spent in a losing exchange cannot.
others: Also deciding now, so choose to work together: {names}.
statePointer: What it knows is under units.{agent} in the state: itself, its weapons and how far they reach, the enemy it has seen (and how far they reach), its orders, its ground and its friends.
statePointerProse: {situation} What it knows is under units.{agent} in the state.
landNote: Only what each unit believes. Enemies it has not found are not listed, and their absence is not evidence that they are not there. A lost contact is where an enemy was last seen, not where it is.
worldNote: Each question is raised from what that agent knows, not the truth. Choose within its doctrine.

optionWords.land.askFriendForHelp: Ask a friend in reach to fire on the shooter, adding guns without moving. Useless if no friend is near.
optionWords.land.assault: Assault the shooter: close and fight through. Only against a clearly weaker enemy at close range; otherwise ruinous.
optionWords.land.betterPosition: Drive to another firing position (hull-down, closer, a flank) before engaging. No fire while moving. Best before the fight starts, when it cannot fire from here, or when an enemy out-ranges it in the open.
optionWords.land.carryOn: Carry on with what it was doing; the crew keeps its drill. Sound when no enemy that can reach it goes unanswered. Blind when an unseen shooter, or an enemy it cannot reach, is hitting it.
optionWords.land.coverFromBearing: Move into cover that masks it from that bearing. This protects it while the shooter is found.
optionWords.land.engageNow: Engage the enemy now, from where it is. Usually right when the enemy is in its reach and it is not outmatched. It does nothing if its weapons cannot reach the enemy.
optionWords.land.goQuietInCover: Stop firing and hide in nearby cover. Useless on open ground with no cover, and it leaves the shooter unanswered.
optionWords.land.helpFriend: Fire on the attacker of the friend in trouble, from here.
optionWords.land.holdHere: Hold the ground here, ready to fire.
optionWords.land.hullDownThenFire: Move hull-down, then return fire. It delays the answer but shrinks what the enemy can hit. Worth the delay when weakened, suppressed or outnumbered.
optionWords.land.keepAtIt: Keep firing on the same target. Wasteful, and it reveals the unit, if its weapons cannot hurt that target.
optionWords.land.keepHoldingHere: Already holding: keep holding here, ready to fire.
optionWords.land.moveToSupport: Move toward the friend in trouble to support it.
optionWords.land.observe: Stop, hold fire and watch. It keeps the contact in view for friends. It is still exposed if the enemy can reach it in the open.
optionWords.land.outOfSight: Pull back out of the enemy's sight. If its weapons out-range the enemy, it can fire from beyond the enemy's reach. Right when outnumbered or weakened in the open.
optionWords.land.outOfTargetSight: Pull back out of the target's sight, where it can no longer be hit by it.
optionWords.land.overwatchHere: Hold here and overwatch: fire at anything in reach.
optionWords.land.pullBackFromBearing: Pull back away from that bearing. It gives up ground and leaves the shooter unfound.
optionWords.land.pullBackToFriends: Turn away and pull back toward friends, out of the enemy's reach. It gives up ground and fire. Only right when it is outmatched or cannot hurt the enemy.
optionWords.land.resumeOrders: Resume its orders and go on with the current step. If the last step is already done, there is nothing left to resume, and moving off gives up the ground it took.
optionWords.land.returnFire: Return fire on the shooter now, from here. Right on even or better terms. Weakened and outnumbered on open ground, it loses the exchange.
optionWords.land.searchBearing: Search the bearing the fire came from to find the shooter, ready to fire on it.
optionWords.land.shiftFireFromTarget: Shift fire to another target its weapons can actually hurt.
optionWords.land.stopFiring: Stop firing and go quiet, so that fire which cannot hurt the target no longer gives its position away.
optionWords.land.waitFor: Hold fire and wait for a better moment (closer, or a flank), then fire. Sound only when hidden or beyond the enemy's reach.
